verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
All I am is all I have
And all, all I have to give
I give it to all to You

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
It's my fagrant oil, is my costly perfume
And I'll take my alabaster box
and I'll, I'll break it open

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Let the fragrance arise
La-la-la-la, la-la-la-la

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
So take every song
Every spoken word
All of my dance, all of my rhyme
And I give it all to you

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
So I pour out all my worship over you
And I sing my song of worship straight to you
